name: nv_revised_statute
description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Nevada Revised Statutes — Nevada state law — by citation. "NRS 200.010" defines murder. Returns the statutory text. Keyless. Use for "what does NRS 484C.110 say" or to check a Nevada statute a case relies on.

section.description: Section as cited, e.g. "200.010" (murder) or "484C.110" (DUI). Chapter is the part before the dot.
